BiblicalUsage: Haroriy means a Harorite, a man from the hill country, and it appears once. In 1 Chronicles 11:27 Shammoth the Harorite stands in the list of David's mighty men, named and counted among the warriors who fought beside the king.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the list is worth reading slowly: a man whose only story is his name and his place still has a place in Scripture.
